External pull resistors on its I/O must be above 50 kΩ, and it must not be used where an open-drain driver sits on the line (SCES650K, revised March 2025, section 7.3.5, read 2026-09-28T13:43:55Z). The line carries the 10 kΩ pull-down and the 1 kΩ pull-up (V58, V64) and the Hitec servo's open-drain output (V61). By its own section 7.4 equation, the 1 kΩ pull-up gives V_OL = 3.3 × 4.5 / (1 + 4.5) = 2.7 V

Each A and B I/O has an internal 10 kΩ pull-up to its supply (SCES651K, revised October 2023, section 8.3.5, read 2026-09-28T13:43:56Z). With the RP2354B held in reset and the gate enabled (V73), the A-side pull-up outweighs the pad's 36 to 113 kΩ pull-down, and the B side sits at 3.3 × 10 / (10 + 10) = 1.65 V against the connector's 10 kΩ pull-down, not low
